Open-channel SSD.subject: Health & Medicine
Open-channel SSD.question: Because of these constraints SSD controllers write data to _____ flash memory in another order than the logical block order
Open-channel SSD.fact: There are three fundamental programming constraints that apply to NAND: a write command must always contain enough data to program one (or several) full flash page(s), writes must be sequential within a block, an erase must be performed before a page within a block can be (re)written. Because of these constraints SSD controllers write data to NAND flash memory in another order than the logical block order.

Open-channel SSD.subject: Health & Medicine
Open-channel SSD.question: This implies that the SSD controller must maintain a mapping table from host (logical) to _____ (physical) addresses
Open-channel SSD.fact: There are three fundamental programming constraints that apply to NAND: a write command must always contain enough data to program one (or several) full flash page(s), writes must be sequential within a block, an erase must be performed before a page within a block can be (re)written. Because of these constraints SSD controllers write data to NAND flash memory in another order than the logical block order.

Open-channel SSD.question: Traditional SSDs maintain the L2P table in _____ on the SSD and use their own CPU for maintaining that L2P table

Open-channel SSD.question: While the _____ SSD approach is more flexible, a significant amount of host memory and host CPU cycles is required for L2P management
